text: *Draft 1:* We often celebrate the massive rise in digital checkouts on library apps like Libby as a sign of success. However, this metric can be misleading. A user might check out ten thrillers in a week but only finish one before the loan expires or they lose interest. If we only measure clicks rather than completion or deep engagement, we miss the reality of reading habits. We should start looking at what actually sticks instead of just counting the digital buttons pressed.
